newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids firm.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids were mostly higher on Monday, supported by another jump in MGE futures, but cold, snowy weather slowed movement in parts of Minnesota and the Dakotas, dealers said.
"We had a really quiet day," one Minnesota dealer said. "Even though we ran the board up, it didn't bring much wheat out of the country."

Temperatures barely climbed above zero Farenheit in parts of North Dakota and Minnesota. The cold, coupled with snowfall amounts up to eight inches in some areas, stalled movement in northern portions of the belt.
But meteorologists said conditions should improve as the week progresses with a gradual warming trend expected before the next round of winter storms moves in this weekend.
